exitStatusDetail: ONE launch drives the regression trio synchronously on the NAPI caller thread ('m1.spike.boot PASS ... logLines=7', 'm2.bridge.smoke PASS ... logLines=17', 'm2.session PASS ... logLines=179' — the 23-event manifest), then the EVENT-DRIVEN binding phase runs scenario m5.host-binding (20/20) over the loopback carrier with ArkWeb mounting the Web Client
carrier: hosts/harmony CarrierServer.ets: loopback HTTP/1.1 static serving of the materialized presentation/web-client files plus a minimal RFC 6455 WS text-frame endpoint at /ws on ONE 127.0.0.1 port (first free from 17877, fail loud after ten); Sec-WebSocket-Accept = base64(sha1(key+GUID)) via the hand-rolled SHA-1 in model/Sha1.ets (documented there; the on-device handshake itself is the proof). HostPhase.ets shuttles session-projection@0 JSON lines between the page and the runtime through the shared bus seam (dsh_spike_set_bus_sink / dsh_spike_bus_deliver); every NAPI call runs on the ArkTS main thread — the ONE serial JS runtime thread (ARCHITECTURE.md §6)
gatewayBinding: binding smoke backend (gateway_smoke.cpp binding mode + forward hook): fsRead/fsWrite/fsScope REAL over the app files scope (fsScope v1: persist = resolve to the app files scope, ref bkm:app), notify REAL (@ohos.notification publish with a wantAgent; the notification tap routes onNewWant -> notify.response), presentApproval REAL (custom ArkUI dialog, driver taps Approve); presentPicker/keychainGet/keychainSet/httpFetch honestly 'unavailable' per the RuntimeDescriptor (5 available / 4 unavailable) — the v2 paths (user-scope fs + persist, HUKS keychain, streaming body bridge) are documented in the agent note; app.state edges ride the UIAbility lifecycle

captures.primary: sink-capture.txt + binding-capture.txt (app-side capture files pulled via hdc file recv from haps/entry/cache/dsh-{spike,host}-capture.log; named .txt because the repo ignores *.log; the binding capture carries the carrier's own canonical lines — module dsh.carrier — alongside the scenario's)
captures.second: logs.txt (continuous `hdc shell hilog` stream filtered to dsh.spike lines; the union of the two capture files is byte-identical to it after stripping the hilog prefix — verified by sorted diff during the evidence run)
captures.scenarioJsonl: scenario.jsonl = grep -h '^dsh.spike.log:' sink-capture.txt binding-capture.txt — the canonical lines of THIS run, extracted by ci/run-host-e2e.sh from the run's own capture files (never synthesized)
captures.screenshots: m5-live-deltas.png (first token delta streaming through the WS into the mounted page) and m5-binding-complete.png (session complete rendered in ArkWeb) — captured via snapshot_display (JPEG), converted in place to real PNG by the runner's documented sips step; human evidence only, never the assertion

uiAutomation: hosts/harmony/ci/run-host-e2e.sh (build -> install -> launch -> drive -> capture -> 4 checkers) with hosts/harmony/ci/drive-binding.mjs tailing the hilog stream and driving the native surfaces over uitest with polled deadlines: the approval dialog's Approve button, the notification-consent dialog's Allow (exact-text match; soft-skip when already granted), Home for the background edge, the notification shade + DSH notification tap for notify.response + foreground
note: Binding run (PR-A): the M5 host is now ISOMORPHIC — one launch proves the regression trio (including the 23-event m2.session with notes.installed) headlessly AND the live carrier topology (listening/mounted/connected/token-deltas/session-complete) plus the real binding primitives on-device. All embedded spike/plugin/web-client files are byte-identical to runtime/spike/, system-plugins/, and presentation/web-client canonicals.
evidenceGapClosure: Full re-run on post-#53 main (fix/evidence-gaps): closes the audit's gaps 2 and 3 — ci/run-host-e2e.sh now extracts scenario.jsonl from the run's own capture files and converts snapshot_display's JPEG to real PNG via a documented sips step (both screenshots re-verified by magic bytes); requires the one-line Index.ets BUNDLE_FILES fix (util-crypto@0.1.6-alpha.1 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2, the rawfile copy #53 shipped), without which the fresh launch died at GetRawfileContent. Verdicts re-matched the committed manifests exactly (7/7, 6/6, 23/23, 20/20).
